## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Feb 18, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _清辰戌_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "The APP is too expensive!!!"
            2. _mmmccc888_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve used the Forest app for over a decade, and even purchased the paid version, in which time I’ve gotten tens of friends to join and have used it religiously throughout college, grad school applications, and entering the workforce. I loved this app. I’m incredibly disappointed in the direction the app has gone, pushing a bigger and more expensive paid option and updating the UI in a way that is glitchy, lags, and no longer tracks time accurately. When I focus longer than the set time, despite having my settings to track extended time, it doesn’t record it. The app also crashes at least once a week or takes 30s-1 min just to switch pages. I’m also sick of having Plus pushed onto me - I have already paid for Forest previously and don’t want my app to continue trying to sell me stuff. This is also not even to mention that I can no longer plant trees in real life or make any kind of real world impact. I will stop using Forest if the glitches and over commercialization do not get fixed."
            3. _Noor_75_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Most of us bought the app to have it forever. Now they’re hitting us with the premium suscription, and now ADS???? yall became so greedy"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _TDTW!_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
<!--/ir-theme-->
